deploy.startCommand: bash -c 'apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3-pip -qq 2>&1 | tail -1; pip3 install --break-system-packages -q google-api-python-client google-auth google-auth-httplib2 google-auth-oauthlib; export PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/data/.playwright; CHROME=$(find /data/.playwright -name chrome -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$CHROME" ] && ! command -v chromium &>/dev/null; then echo Installing Chromium to volume...; PW=$(node -e "try{console.log(require(\x27/usr/local/lib/node_modules/playwright-core/package.json\x27).version)}catch(e){console.log(\x27latest\x27)}" 2>/dev/null || echo latest); npx playwright@$PW install --with-deps chromium 2>&1 | tail -5; CHROME=$(find /data/.playwright -name chrome -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$CHROME" ] && ln -sf "$CHROME" /usr/local/bin/chromium; fi; exec /entrypoint.sh'
